package_choice: No new package/version or agent framework. Deterministic external source examples; existing public APIs only.
trusted_owner: New frozen qualification-only entry derives accepted bounded EQ108 ownership and SDK transport; owns actual fixed native batch/config and constructs a content-consistent receipt using public make_content_receipt after complete native-producer verification. Never alter accepted EQ108 zero-hash declaration fixture or reconstruct a native HTTP receipt.
boundaries: Calculation packages unchanged/source-independent; no source, sink, ledger or model inside calculation/MCP handlers.
MCP descriptors retain input_content_verified=False/source_authenticated=False/execution_verified=False. Outer supplied-content consistency is separate.
Ledger consistency, independently retained terminal anchor, payload retention, narrative fidelity, replay and diagnostic admission are separate observations.
No unstructured-language understanding, paid inference, actual human approval, trading execution, authenticity, physical quota/hard cleanup/power-loss/hosted claim.

narrative.grammar: Exact ASCII session.trade.count=<canonical nonnegative decimal integer>; max128bytes; no whitespace, leading plus/zeros, bool/float aliases or free prose accepted as verified.
narrative.rule: Only supplied available count at exact A/S context may match; unavailable value never matches a literal null or grants permission. Matching arithmetic does not override unknown diagnostics.
narrative.missing_input_rule: Known result/narrative may still match when an input is missing; supplied config/result/receipt bindings must validate and all actually supplied bytes must match. Use a reference-only bundle and report replay unavailable0, never call full-input verification with a missing batch as if verified.

event_sequence: one ToolCall/ToolResult pair per actual consumer call_tool operation, including every chunk continuation
feature_read referring actual result event and complete/missing retained receipt reference
event_contract: Use unchanged EQ106 subjects/16KiB event bounds. <=32actual tool calls =><=68events (2request/model+64call/result+1read+1decision). Init/list/control/preparation are separately witnessed protocol/owner activity, not falsely claimed full agent history. Store exports use fixed terminal and enough <=64event pages; entire store.verify(expected) and independent full chain compare. Each event references <=16indexed earlier targets; pure per-event checks supply only required retained targets, not an over-limit whole context. Payloads retained externally; every actual ToolResult wire is distinguished from assembled report/receipt bytes. Independent stdlib canonical JSON+SHA256 computes expected actual event bytes/links before append and terminal is retained outside SQLite.
decision_precedence: Exact type/size/graph admission failure -> fixed error before encoding/hash; invalid_input for types, limit_exceeded for bounds.
Any present malformed/noncanonical/wrong-context/wrong-content report or inconsistent supplied content -> inconsistent_evidence; absence is not corruption.
After all present evidence validates, narrative mismatch -> REJECT/mismatch.
Missing report, missing retained input, unavailable count or unsupported narrative -> DEFER/incomplete_evidence.
Otherwise -> DEFER/diagnostic_not_admitted: selected advisory unknown report always has not_applied admission. No OBSERVE/ADMIT branch.

bounds.scope: Application/qualification bounds only; no total physical resource or active-callback/kernel deadline promise. Exact operation ledgers/source/owner/helper identities must be frozen/reviewed before execution.

privacy: Synthetic fixed labels only; no prompts/credentials/environment capture/hidden chain-of-thought. Caller labels and model/human-review times remain unauthenticated. Redact before event append; original plaintext/backups persist.
error_policy: Examples expose closed ResearchExampleError codes invalid_input,inconsistent_evidence,limit_exceeded,unsupported; no raw payloads/SQL/token/backend messages in public summaries. Existing public package errors keep their accepted semantics; no best-effort repair or mutation replay.

No report chunks on missing presence. Original native computations2; replay0.

native_lanes.future_known_pure: Actual fixed public pure compute_trades with lastknown211 produces five missing_input/future_knowledge rows, original pure computation1 and replay1; no claim this is new native/MCP producer proof.
native_lanes.control_scope: Expiry/retirement uses a separately frozen trusted owner control, never a caller provider/clock selector. Every grant-backed read remains actual backend authority; no token replay or guessed clock outcome.

assessment_schema.representation: Frozen examples-only Assessment dataclass, exact fields; no dict/subclass/extra fields. Not a public package schema.

fields.output_status: str: verified (only returned after full selected result content match)

outer_result_schema.representation: Frozen ResearchObservation(assessment:Assessment, replay:ReplayObservation, ledger:LedgerObservation, model_status:str). Closed exact fields, no payloads in summary.

ReplayObservation.status: str: not_requested OR unchanged accepted ReplayReport.status; never fabricate a ReplayReport
ReplayObservation.calculation_count: int not bool: 0|1; not_requested0, unavailable/incompatible/cancelled_before_start0, matched1 in chosen cases
ReplayObservation.rule: Capture actual public report and actual invocation count. Missing required report ->not_requested0; missing retained input with reference-only bundle ->actual unavailable0. Changed evidence refuses before invocation.

LedgerObservation.consistency: str: verified|unavailable; verified only from actual complete store.verify result and independent full event chain equality
LedgerObservation.anchor: str: matched|not_supplied|not_covered|mismatch|unavailable; preserve actual expected-terminal semantics, never equate valid prefix with corruption
LedgerObservation.payload_retention: str: complete|missing; full current referenced bytes checked independently
LedgerObservation.rule: No supplied external terminal ->not_supplied. Absent store ->unavailable. A shortened consistent prefix with later external anchor reports not_covered/mismatch and refuses anchored success; no repaired success.

outer_result_schema.model_status: literal not_supplied in this selected example; model label unavailable unauthenticated. Matching replay/anchor/retention cannot override DEFER. Missing anchor/retention also requires DEFER unless already REJECT; preserves separate factual axes.
